<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
<title>JB Aquarelle — Œuvres originales</title>
<meta name="description" content="JB Aquarelle — Aquarelles originales, prints et cartes postales. Féternes, Haute-Savoie."/>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 32 32'><rect width='32' height='32' fill='%231A1814'/><text x='16' y='23' font-family='Georgia' font-size='18' font-style='italic' fill='%23F8F5F0' text-anchor='middle'>J</text></svg>"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;1,400;1,500&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
:root{
  --bg:#FAFAF8;--bg2:#F2EEE8;--ink:#1A1814;--ink2:#7A736C;
  --a:#7B9E87;--g:#C9A96E;
  --serif:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;
  --sans:'DM Sans',Helvetica,sans-serif
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans)}

/* SPLASH */
.splash{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;background:var(--ink);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:opacity .8s ease 1.2s,visibility .8s ease 1.2s}
.splash.done{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
#sb{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:28px;color:var(--bg);letter-spacing:.4em;text-transform:uppercase;animation:fadeIn 1s ease forwards}
@keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0;letter-spacing:.7em}to{opacity:1;letter-spacing:.4em}}

/* NAV */
.nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;height:64px;background:rgba(250,250,248,.95);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(26,24,20,.07);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 40px}
.nav-brand{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:none;color:var(--ink)}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:28px}
.nav-links button{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10px;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink);opacity:.5;transition:opacity .2s}
.nav-links button:hover{opacity:1}
.nav-cart{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.nbadge{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--a);color:#fff;font-size:9px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}

/* HERO */
.hero{height:calc(100vh - 64px);position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:0 40px 72px}
.hbg{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center;animation:zoom 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes zoom{from{transform:scale(1)}to{transform:scale(1.05)}}
.hov{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(155deg,rgba(26,24,20,.06) 0%,rgba(26,24,20,.62) 100%)}
.hc{position:relative;z-index:2}
.hsub{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10px;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);margin-bottom:16px}
.htitle{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(52px,9vw,120px);font-weight:400;font-style:italic;color:#fff;line-height:.92}
.hbtn{display:inline-block;margin-top:40px;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;padding:14px 40px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);cursor:pointer;background:none;transition:all .28s}
.hbtn:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}

/* SECTIONS */
.sec{padding:80px 40px}
.ey{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--a);margin-bottom:14px}
.stitle{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,62px);font-style:italic;line-height:1.05;margin-bottom:48px}

/* CARDS */
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:3px}
.card{cursor:pointer;background:#fff;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.ciw{overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.cimg{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.card:hover .cimg{transform:scale(1.06)}
.cbody{padding:16px 20px 22px}
.ccat{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--a);margin-bottom:7px}
.cname{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:18px;margin-bottom:5px}
.cprice{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2)}
.badge{position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;color:#fff;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 10px}
.bnew{background:var(--a)}
.buniq{background:var(--g);top:auto;bottom:12px}

/* BAND */
.band{background:var(--ink);padding:80px 40px;text-align:center}
.bandq{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(22px,4vw,52px);font-style:italic;color:var(--bg);line-height:1.22}
.bandq span{color:var(--g)}

/* ABOUT GRID */
.abgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:64px;align-items:center}
.abimg{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover}
.abt{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(24px,3.5vw,40px);font-style:italic;line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:20px}
.abp{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:14px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.9;color:var(--ink2);margin-bottom:28px}

/* NEWSLETTER */
.nlsec{background:var(--bg2);padding:72px 40px;text-align:center}
.nlt{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(22px,4vw,46px);font-style:italic;margin-bottom:10px}
.nls{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:13px;font-weight:300;color:var(--ink2);margin-bottom:32px}
.nlrow{display:flex;max-width:460px;margin:0 auto}
.nlinp{flex:1;padding:14px 18px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-right:none;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:13px;background:#fff;outline:none}
.nlbtn{padding:14px 26px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;border:none;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}

/* TABS */
.tabs{display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid #e4dfd8;margin-bottom:36px;overflow-x:auto}
.tab{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:13px 24px;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink);opacity:.38;white-space:nowrap;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-1px;transition:all .2s}
.tab.on{opacity:1;border-bottom-color:var(--a)}

/* PRODUCT PAGE */
.pdpage{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;min-height:100vh}
.pdimg{width:100%;height:100vh;object-fit:cover;position:sticky;top:0}
.pdinfo{padding:72px 56px 80px}
.pdback{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);opacity:.4;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:48px;transition:opacity .2s}
.pdback:hover{opacity:1}
.pdcat{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--a);border:1px solid var(--a);padding:5px 14px;margin-bottom:18px}
.pdname{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,54px);font-style:italic;line-height:1.05;margin-bottom:14px}
.pdprice{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:22px;font-weight:300;margin-bottom:36px}
.pddesc{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:14px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.9;color:var(--ink2);margin-bottom:40px}

/* ABOUT PAGE */
.ahero{height:70vh;position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:0 40px 64px}
.ahbg{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center}
.ahov{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(26,24,20,.65) 0%,rgba(26,24,20,.1) 55%)}
.aht{position:relative;z-index:2;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(40px,8vw,100px);font-style:italic;color:#fff}
.proc{background:var(--bg2);padding:80px 40px}
.procg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:48px;margin-top:48px}
.procn{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:52px;font-style:italic;color:var(--a);opacity:.35;line-height:1;margin-bottom:12px}
.proct{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:20px;font-style:italic;margin-bottom:10px}
.procp{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:13px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.8;color:var(--ink2)}

/* CONTACT PAGE */
.ctpage{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;min-height:100vh}
.ctl{background:var(--ink);padding:80px 48px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}
.ctt{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,64px);font-style:italic;color:var(--bg);line-height:1.06}
.ctinfo{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;margin-top:40px}
.cilbl{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(250,250,248,.35);display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
.civ{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:13px;color:var(--bg);font-weight:300}
.ctr{padding:80px 48px}
.ctrt{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:32px;font-style:italic;margin-bottom:36px}

/* FORMS */
.fg{margin-bottom:16px}
.flbl{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.5;display:block;margin-bottom:8px}
.fi{width:100%;padding:13px 16px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid #dad5ce;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:13px;color:var(--ink);outline:none;transition:border-color .2s}
.fi:focus{border-color:var(--a)}
textarea.fi{min-height:100px;resize:vertical}
select.fi{cursor:pointer}

/* BUTTONS */
.btnd{padding:17px 36px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background .25s}
.btnd:hover{background:var(--a)}
.btnd.full{width:100%}
.btno{padding:15px 32px;background:none;color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid var(--ink);cursor:pointer;transition:all .22s}
.btno:hover{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg)}
.btndanger{background:none;color:#c0392b;border:1px solid #c0392b;padding:15px 28px;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:all .22s}
.btndanger:hover{background:#c0392b;color:#fff}

/* CART */
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;background:rgba(26,24,20,.36);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .32s}
.ov.on{opacity:1;pointer-events:all}
.drawer{position:fixed;right:0;top:0;bottom:0;z-index:201;width:400px;max-width:95vw;background:var(--bg);padding:40px;transform:translateX(110%);transition:transform .42s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow-y:auto}
.drawer.on{transform:translateX(0)}
.drhead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:36px}
.drt{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:28px;font-style:italic}
.drx{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.4}
.citem{display:flex;gap:14px;padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #e8e2da}
.citem img{width:64px;height:80px;object-fit:cover;flex-shrink:0}
.cin{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:15px;margin-bottom:4px}
.cicat{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--a);margin-bottom:10px}
.cip{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px;color:var(--ink2);margin-bottom:12px}
.qrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.qbtn{width:26px;height:26px;border:1px solid #ccc;background:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:all .18s}
.qbtn:hover{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border-color:var(--ink)}
.qnum{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:13px;min-width:16px;text-align:center}
.rmbtn{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#bbb;margin-top:8px;display:block}
.drfoot{margin-top:auto;padding-top:24px}
.drtot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:20px}
.dtl{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.45}
.dtv{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:24px;font-style:italic}

/* CHECKOUT */
.ckpage{padding:100px 40px;max-width:600px;margin:0 auto}
.ckt{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,52px);font-style:italic;margin-bottom:44px}
.ckrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #e8e2da;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:13px;font-weight:300}
.cktot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:22px 0;margin-bottom:36px}
.cktl{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink2)}
.cktv{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:26px;font-style:italic}
.paynote{padding:16px 18px;background:#fff;border-left:3px solid var(--a);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.7;margin-top:16px}

/* CONFIRM */
.confirm{min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:40px}

/* LOGIN */
.lp{min-height:100vh;display:flex}
.lpl{flex:1;background-size:cover;background-position:center}
.lpr{width:420px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:44px;background:var(--bg)}
.lpt{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:38px;font-style:italic;margin-bottom:6px}
.lps{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--a);margin-bottom:44px}

/* ADMIN */
.adm{padding:60px 40px 80px}
.admh{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,60px);font-style:italic;margin-bottom:6px}
.admsub{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--a);margin-bottom:48px}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;margin-bottom:56px}
.sc{background:#fff;padding:24px}
.scv{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:42px;font-style:italic}
.scl{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.38;margin-top:6px}
.adms{margin-bottom:56px}
.admsh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:18px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #e4dfd8}
.admst{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--a)}
.ot{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}
.ot th{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink2);padding:10px 12px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid #e4dfd8}
.ot td{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px;font-weight:300;padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #f2eee8}
.sbadge{background:rgba(123,158,135,.14);color:var(--a);padding:3px 10px;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
.admgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:12px}
.apc{background:#fff;padding:14px;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid transparent;transition:all .22s}
.apc:hover{border-color:var(--a)}
.apc img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover;margin-bottom:10px}
.apcn{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:14px}
.apcp{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:11px;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:2px}
.apcst{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10px;margin-top:2px}
.apcst.low{color:#c0392b}
.addcard{background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:140px;border:2px dashed #ddd;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s}
.addcard:hover{border-color:var(--a)}

/* MODAL */
.mkov{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:300;background:rgba(26,24,20,.48);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px}
.modal{background:var(--bg);padding:48px;max-width:560px;width:100%;max-height:92vh;overflow-y:auto}
.modalt{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:32px;font-style:italic;margin-bottom:32px}
.macts{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:30px;flex-wrap:wrap}

/* TOAST */
.toast{position:fixed;top:76px;right:20px;z-index:700;background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);padding:12px 22px;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8px);transition:all .35s}
.toast.on{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}

/* COOKIE */
.cookie{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:800;background:var(--ink);padding:16px 40px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cookt{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px;color:rgba(250,250,248,.6);flex:1;line-height:1.6}
.ckacc{background:var(--a);color:#fff;border:none;padding:10px 22px;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer}
.ckref{background:none;color:rgba(250,250,248,.4);border:1px solid rgba(250,250,248,.2);padding:10px 22px;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer}

/* LEGAL */
.legalsec{margin-bottom:32px}
.legalt{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:22px;font-style:italic;margin-bottom:10px}
.legalp{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:13px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.85;color:var(--ink2)}

/* FOOTER */
footer{background:var(--ink);padding:72px 40px 40px}
.ft{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:44px;margin-bottom:52px}
.fb{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:20px;font-style:italic;color:var(--bg);margin-bottom:10px}
.ftag{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:11.5px;color:rgba(250,250,248,.3);line-height:1.7}
.fh{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(250,250,248,.28);margin-bottom:16px}
.fl{display:block;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px;color:rgba(250,250,248,.5);background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;padding:5px 0;transition:color .2s}
.fl:hover{color:var(--bg)}
.fbot{border-top:1px solid rgba(250,250,248,.08);padding-top:24px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.fcopy{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:11px;color:rgba(250,250,248,.22)}

/* RESPONSIVE */
@media(max-width:900px){
  .nav{padding:0 20px}.nav-links{display:none}
  .hero{padding:0 20px 56px}
  .sec,.band,.nlsec,.adm,.ckpage,.proc{padding-left:20px;padding-right:20px}
  .ahero{padding:0 20px 48px;height:50vh}
  .abgrid,.pdpage,.ctpage{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .pdimg{height:68vw;position:static}.pdinfo{padding:36px 20px 60px}
  .ctl,.ctr{padding:48px 20px}
  .procg{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px}
  .ft{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px}
  footer{padding:56px 20px 36px}
  .cookie{padding:14px 20px}
  .drawer{width:100vw}
  .stats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .lpl{display:none}.lpr{width:100%}
  .modal{padding:32px 20px}
}

/* Ajouts performance */
#sb{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:28px;color:var(--bg);letter-spacing:.4em;text-transform:uppercase}
.legalsec{margin-bottom:32px}
.legalt{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:22px;font-style:italic;margin-bottom:10px}
.legalp{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:13px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.85;color:var(--ink2)}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- Images locales (ne bloquent pas le rendu car display:none) -->
<img id="li1" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," style="display:none" alt=""/>
<img id="li2" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," style="display:none" alt=""/>

<!-- SPLASH (réduit à 800ms) -->
<div class="splash" id="splash"><p id="sb">JB Aquarelle</p></div>

<!-- TOAST -->
<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

<!-- COOKIE -->
<div class="cookie" id="cookie">
  <p class="cookt">Nous utilisons des cookies pour améliorer votre expérience.</p>
  <div style="display:flex;gap:10px">
    <button class="ckacc" onclick="document.getElementById('cookie').style.display='none'">Accepter</button>
